newsitem.title: UK: UK's JFX Ukraine JV signs gas supply deal.
newsitem.headline: UK's JFX Ukraine JV signs gas supply deal.

text.p: British exploration group JKX Oil & Gas Plc said on Tuesday its Ukrainian joint venture Poltava Petroleum Company (PPC) had signed a gas supply agreement with state-owned UKRAGAS.
The agreement covers gas sales to six regional distributors in Ukraine and more contracts were expected to be signed imminently, JKX said in a statement.

JKX said PPC would supply 227 million cubic metres of storage gas and its available gas production for the remainder of 1997 for $50 per thousand cubic metres net of value-added-tax and transportation charges.
